title: Robit/Beholder shared wire contracts
description: Single language-neutral source of truth for the cross-plugin wire contracts shared between robit (Python) and beholder (TypeScript). Generated Python and TS types must match these definitions; the codegen --check mode fails CI if the hand-written robit dataclasses drift from this schema. Field names, types, defaults and optionality mirror the Wave-1 final shapes in robit/core/events.py, robit/core/verdict.py and robit/protocol/jsonrpc.py exactly.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: robit/core/verdict.py Verdict (frozen dataclass). The single structured veto representation.

plugin.description: Name of the engine that issued the verdict.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase the verdict fired in.

pattern_id.description: Structured pattern identifier; null when the engine carries no pattern taxonomy.

pattern_name.description: Human-readable pattern name; null when unknown.

severity.description: Severity classification; defaults to 'veto' for a hard block.

EnchantedEvent.title: EnchantedEvent
EnchantedEvent.description: robit/core/events.py EnchantedEvent (frozen dataclass). Cross-plugin lingua franca for the in-process bus.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON-serialisable mapping; defaults to empty object.

schema_version.description: G3 contract version (CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION). Decoders treat a missing field as 1.

hop_count.description: G5 cycle/depth guard. Re-publish hop count; root events start at 0.

PluginAck.title: PluginAck
PluginAck.description: robit/core/events.py PluginAck (mutable dataclass). A subscriber's response to an event.

derived_events.description: Events to be re-published; defaults to empty list.

verdict.description: G1 structured veto. Present when status == 'veto'; optional, default null.

JsonRpcErrorCode.title: JsonRpcErrorCode
JsonRpcErrorCode.description: robit/protocol/jsonrpc.py ErrorCode IntEnum. Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 codes plus the robit custom -32099..-32000 reserved range.
